ic_name: IEEE 1149.1 JTAG TAP Controller (TI SSYA002C primer)
fsm_summary: 16-state Moore machine. TMS is sampled on the rising edge of TCK; the next state depends only on the current state and the latched TMS. TDO is driven combinationally from the selected register output and is updated on the falling edge of TCK; TDO is 3-state active only in ShiftIR and ShiftDR.

fsm_states_tap_controller.name: TestLogicReset
fsm_states_tap_controller.description: All test logic disabled; device runs normally. Entry loads IDCODE (if implemented) else BYPASS into the current-instruction latch. Reached unconditionally by TMS=1 for ≥ 5 TCKs or asynchronously by TRST=LOW.

fsm_states_tap_controller.name: RunTestIdle
fsm_states_tap_controller.description: Test logic is enabled and idle; instruction-dependent — e.g. during RUNBIST the device runs its self-test in this state.

fsm_states_tap_controller.name: SelectDRScan
fsm_states_tap_controller.description: Branch state: TMS=0 → CaptureDR; TMS=1 → SelectIRScan.

fsm_states_tap_controller.name: CaptureDR
fsm_states_tap_controller.description: On the rising edge of TCK, parallel-load the DR selected by the current instruction (e.g. capture input pins into BSR; load IDCODE into Device ID register; load 0 into Bypass).

fsm_states_tap_controller.name: ShiftDR
fsm_states_tap_controller.description: Shift the selected DR one bit per TCK rising edge: TDI → LSB of DR; previous MSB → TDO on falling edge.

fsm_states_tap_controller.name: PauseDR
fsm_states_tap_controller.description: Temporarily halt shifting (e.g. for tester to refill its vector buffer) without losing register contents.

fsm_states_tap_controller.name: UpdateDR
fsm_states_tap_controller.description: On the falling edge of TCK, parallel-latch the shifted DR contents into the device's effective state (e.g. drive output pins in EXTEST; commit configuration write).

fsm_states_tap_controller.name: CaptureIR
fsm_states_tap_controller.description: On the rising edge of TCK, parallel-load the IR with the spec-mandated pattern b...b01 (LSB pair must be '01' so tester can verify IR liveness).

fsm_states_tap_controller.name: ShiftIR
fsm_states_tap_controller.description: Shift the IR one bit per TCK rising edge: TDI → LSB of IR; previous MSB → TDO on falling edge.

fsm_states_tap_controller.name: PauseIR
fsm_states_tap_controller.description: Temporarily halt IR shifting; IR contents preserved.

fsm_states_tap_controller.name: UpdateIR
fsm_states_tap_controller.description: On the falling edge of TCK, parallel-latch the shifted IR into the current-instruction latch, switching the active instruction.

fsm_transition_table_tms_driven.notes: 16 entries × 2 next-states. Sampled on TCK rising edge.

fsm_hints.clock: TCK free-running, generated by the tester.
fsm_hints.sampling_edge: TMS and TDI sampled on rising edge of TCK.
fsm_hints.drive_edge: TDO updated on falling edge of TCK so that the next device in the daisy chain samples cleanly on the next rising edge.
fsm_hints.abort: TMS=1 for 5 consecutive TCKs unconditionally returns to TestLogicReset from any state. TRST=LOW (if implemented) is the asynchronous equivalent.
fsm_hints.instruction_change_path: From RunTestIdle (or TestLogicReset): TMS=1 → SelectDRScan → TMS=1 → SelectIRScan → TMS=0 → CaptureIR → TMS=0 → ShiftIR → shift IR opcode LSB-first → TMS=1 → Exit1IR → TMS=1 → UpdateIR → instruction is now active.
fsm_hints.data_scan_path: From RunTestIdle: TMS=1 → SelectDRScan → TMS=0 → CaptureDR → TMS=0 → ShiftDR → shift DR data LSB-first → TMS=1 → Exit1DR → TMS=1 → UpdateDR → committed.

anti_deadlock_rule: TMS=1 × 5 TCKs is the universal escape — there is no FSM state from which this sequence does not reach TestLogicReset. This guarantees the tester can always recover the FSM to a known state without TRST.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: On power-up the TAP controller may be in any state. TI's primer (and IEEE 1149.1) require that 5 TCKs of TMS=1 must always reach TestLogicReset. Many devices also implement an internal asynchronous reset that forces TestLogicReset at power-on; TRST (when provided) is the dedicated asynchronous reset input.

default_ready_state_recommendation.TCK: Idle level not specified; tester drives.
default_ready_state_recommendation.TMS: Pulled HIGH on board so a missing tester defaults the device toward TestLogicReset.
default_ready_state_recommendation.TDI: Pulled HIGH on board so a missing tester naturally shifts all-1s (BYPASS opcode) into IR.
default_ready_state_recommendation.TDO: 3-state when not in ShiftIR / ShiftDR; may be pulled to a known level externally for bus integrity.

configurations.name: Self-contained TAP
configurations.description: Single device with its own TAP controller; tester drives TCK/TMS/TDI; reads TDO.

configurations.name: Daisy-chained TAPs
configurations.description: Several devices share TCK + TMS; their TDI/TDO are wired tail-to-head.

timing_dependency_rule: All FSM state transitions and IR/DR shifts are synchronous to the rising edge of TCK. TDO is driven on the falling edge of TCK with a tCKQ propagation delay specified per device. Setup/hold of TMS / TDI relative to rising edge of TCK is per-device.
